reason: My Instagram is my storefront and my proof, and this sends DMs from it. Nothing here tells me it won't get the account restricted, and there are no customer results at all. I make about $2.6k a month, so $147 on an unproven tool that puts my main account at risk isn't worth it.
objection: Will this get my Instagram restricted or banned? It sends from my own account, and they don't say it's safe. Losing months of content and clients over a tool with zero published results is a bad trade.
would_change_my_mind: Real customers who run it on their main account, with proof they've used it for months without a restriction, plus a trial I can run with no card on file.
